title: Restoring SETI budget and closed-door seminar to SETI scientists
place_text: House of Representatives; Jet Propulsion Laboratory

tellings.quote: I went with you know Rusty Schwab and a whole bunch of the schwier and a bunch of the other folks uh and we went around and talked to the Congress people and they put the money back in

plain: In 1977, funding for SETI, the scientific search for radio signals from alien civilisations, was cut and then put back after people lobbied Congress, and SETI scientists at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory were given a closed-door seminar. Dan Sheehan, who says he took part, tells Michels he went around with Rusty Schweickart and others to talk to members of Congress, "and they put the money back in." He also names Marcia Smith in connection with it. If true, it would mean a quiet push from outside kept the government's search for alien life alive.
